attributes.speakers: 240,000 in Cameroon (2005 estimate). Another source says over 100,000.
attributes.family: A Grassfields language of the Ring group (Niger-Congo, Southern Bantoid).
attributes.region: Bui Division, in the Northwest Region.
attributes.other_languages_used: Cameroon Pidgin English, English, Limbum and Oku.
attributes.writing: Written since the 1940s, when Nso schoolteachers developed a spelling system on their own initiative to teach primary school pupils in their own language before they moved on to English.
attributes.bible: The Bible translation began in 1971. The New Testament was available for many years, and the complete Bible was dedicated in November 2016, together with a Lamnso' dictionary.
attributes.references: Anderson, S. C. (2015), A phonological sketch of Lamnso', SIL Cameroon. McGarrity and Botne (2001), Between agreement and case marking in Lamnso.
